summary: PetVivo Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the partial exercise of a purchase option under a March 2026 Subscription Agreement, receiving $150,000 in gross proceeds and issuing 187,500 Units at $0.80/Unit, each consisting of one common share and a warrant exercisable at $1.10/share for three years. To date, total investment is $1,150,000 for 1,437,500 Units. The investor retains the option to purchase up to an additional $1,350,000 of Units through July 15, 2026. The offering is an exempt equity financing under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D with an accredited investor. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
